summary: The Wii Itadaki Street crossover localized as Fortune Street in North America and Boom Street in Europe.

entries.title: Fortune Street
entries.definitive_edition: Original Wii release captured through Dolphin

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin with a legal Wii disc dump, progressive scan, and scaled internal resolution. Dolphin's game page reports playable/excellent historical testing while noting EFB behavior, so verify depth-of-field/board visuals before final capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dolphin HD internal resolution with original Wii assets

primary.version: Original Wii release via Dolphin for archive capture
primary.why: Fortune Street is a December 2011 Wii release, with regional names Boom Street, Course à la Fortune, Itadaki Street, La Via della Fortuna, and Straßen des Glücks. There is no PC, HD remaster, or later port of this specific Mario/Dragon Quest Wii crossover, so the highest-fidelity route is the Wii disc through Dolphin with internal-resolution scaling while preserving the original Wii content.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Wii disc in Dolphin. Enable progressive scan, use a modern development build, raise internal resolution to taste, and verify board effects since EFB behavior can vary; official Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection online play is discontinued, so plan for local multiplayer or documented replacement-network testing outside the official route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official HD remaster or PC port is sourced. Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection online features for Wii software were discontinued on May 20, 2014, so the official online mode is no longer available even though local play and solo content remain.
